Well I have possible intestinal cancer lets just say always in pain! Pothead to the core! I have never shot up drugs ever except when a nurse cant get the foley or lance in to gimme my relief.
Marinol just didn't do the trick even 2 or 3 so my retarded ass decided to iv inject marinol and pure iv water into my vein. I put the lance into 5mg pearls sucking out the good stuff. It's difficult getting 100% of it but I kept having to suck that pure water to dilute - the stuff is thick. I used 3 pills got approx 85% of it and stuck it in there.
Well it worked folks. Stoned to the bone. I did take a bong hit of some dirt but I am blowed. It helps with the pain plus I ate more than usual that was awsome. Not gonna do this often wanna talk to a doc bout doin this but it worked for me just hope the ol arm dosen't fall off.
